transcript_raw:
Participant: P04 | Session 2 | GTA V | minimal HUD | Interviewer: Researcher 2
[00:00] Interviewer: Okay [name], thanks. Let's start the interview for session 2.
[00:10] Interviewer: Q1. How did you figure out where to go during the session? What did you look at or rely on?
[00:17] P04: like, you know, I just kind of guessed which uhm direction to go.
[00:49] Interviewer: Q2. Were there moments when something on the screen confused you? What was happening?
[00:57] P04: ahh, uh, yeah I got lost a lot because there was no map.
[01:33] Interviewer: Q3. Which HUD elements, if any, pulled your attention away from what you were doing?
[01:37] P04: um, you know, I was focused uh, on the world itself, the streets and the people. I usually stream as [username] so I play a lot.
[02:09] Interviewer: Q4. Was there any HUD element that didn't work the way you expected?
[02:14] P04: like, uh, [silence 8s] the prompts were easy um, to miss without the other stuff.
[02:34] Interviewer: Q5. How aware were you of the passing of time while playing?
[02:38] P04: ahh, uh, I lost track of time, it felt like I like, was really in the city. My friend [name] told me it's the same in other games.
[03:03] Interviewer: Q6. Was there a point where you had to stop to figure out what the game was telling you?
[03:10] P04: um, uh, yes, I had to like, stop many times and open the full map.
[03:40] Interviewer: Q7. What information, if any, did you feel was missing from the screen?
[03:45] P04: uhm uh, I wanted the minimap back, and the objective distance.
[04:13] Interviewer: Q8. What would you change about the HUD you just used, and why?
[04:17] P04: you know, like, I would add a small compass so I do not get lost but keep it clean.
[04:46] Interviewer: Q9. Was there a moment in either session where you felt completely absorbed? What was on screen?
[04:52] P04: uh, uhm [silence 7s] in the session um, without the map, when I was just driving around at night.
[05:26] Interviewer: Q10. Comparing both sessions, which HUD setup gave you the better experience exploring, and why?
[05:30] P04: uhm ahh, [silence 7s] the full one because uhm I did not waste time getting lost. My friend [name] told me it's the same in other games.
[05:56] Interviewer: Q11. In which session was it easier to understand what was happening and what to do next?
[06:03] P04: uhm um, the full HUD was easier to understand what to do next.
[06:21] Interviewer: Q12. If you could design your own HUD, which elements would you keep and which would you remove?
[06:26] P04: you know, uh, I would keep health and a compass and remove the notifications. I usually stream as [username] so I play a lot.
